summary: Very steep narrow street with no-parking signs and homes close by.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 12 m or so from the east kerb, tree-covered gardens between.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane on a steep hill; no pull-off, kerb-to-fence.
drivers.convention: A few cars park on the west side; two No Parking Any Time signs cover this kerb.

sun_shade: Dense tree shade over the east side most of the length.
